synopsis: JARI in Japan is named alongside CEREMA, CARISSMA and NIED as a main source of ground truth for weather models; weather chambers at these institutions, together with proving grounds, underpin sensor-model validation [f5056, f16122, f5119]. Fog is the best-reproduced condition for lidar, with JARI, CEREMA and CARISSMA fog chambers providing on-road evidence [f4640]. However, the booklet did not examine facility booking lead times, capacity or suitability for heavy off-road machines of the size in scope, leaving practical access and applicability unresolved [f16124, f5120]. These access questions directly affect model validation before mid-2027 [f5120].
